study.question: At the reduced cart/fav parameter budget, can reallocating shallow width to the history-detail residual, a second nonlinear stage, or both recover auxiliary discrimination while preserving the strongest click result and its measured efficiency frontier?
study.hypothesis: Observation: round42 at a fixed first width48 preserved click AUC0.6671669182126774 in all four cells, but private quality declined: reference cart/fav0.6650908/0.6896716; residual removal0.6601308/0.6768725; shallow with residual0.6722570/0.6547515; combined removal0.6316071/0.6438528. The combined cell used204837 dense parameters versus212533 and reduced p50 from15.359 to14.895ms, but inference wall only25.77 to25.47s, below a5% wall-cost gate. Hypothesis: the removed detail adapter and nonlinear stage carry private predictive information that cannot be efficiently replaced by shallow width, so reallocating a nearly fixed budget may recover private AUC. No improvement is yet measured. Freeze before screening: click preservation requires candidate AUC >= contemporaneous joint_budget_reference AUC -0.0002 AND >=0.6669669182126774 (frozen current best0.6671669182126774 minus0.0002), with original entry utility separately requiring >=0.666553547526167. The original entry and DIN remain utility references, not matched architectural controls. A cost-neutral reallocation requires dense parameters <=204837 and validation inference wall and p95 latency each <=1.02 times the contemporaneous shallow reference. A new efficiency claim additionally needs >=5% lower measured inference wall and p95 than a contemporaneously rerun strongest click model or original entry, under the same host protocol, confirmed in repetitions; a parameter count alone is not a speed claim. Private auxiliary recovery is predeclared as mean(cart AUC,fav AUC) increase >=0.005 with neither task falling >0.005 and neither Logloss increasing >0.001 relative to the shallow reference. This is a secondary diagnostic, never the primary selection score. Select/freeze by validation click preservation and measured cost only; report auxiliary quality separately, including substantial losses relative to DIN and the earlier joint model. Earlier embedding/scorer cuts and projection-sharing failures show that generic compression can hurt click; rounds40/41 show ownership matters. No assumptions transfer those failures or successes automatically to this reduced-budget replacement. Quantitative trajectory review: DIN click AUC0.6555440824200336; original joint entry0.666753547526167; embedding12 screening0.6641111848808231; scorer-half0.6654368615912554; shared-projection reuse0.6648248738234025; auxiliary tower reduction before buy-only ownership0.6657436780708307. These runs executed successfully but lost predictive quality; they are scientific negative comparisons, not runtime failures. Later ownership-matched reductions preserved0.6671669182126774, which motivates allocation within private heads rather than another global size cut. Cost claims must report both the strongest-click and original-entry comparators separately, with no post-hoc choice of the more favorable reference. No withheld outcome has been requested or consumed.

nearest_work.difference: Closest implementation and budget reference; retain its mechanism and use existing constructor controls to reallocate cart/fav head capacity. No new architecture or priority claim.

Previous fixed-width 2x2 removed residual/depth separately. This study changes compensating first widths to approximately match private budgets; previous fixed-width evidence and this replacement evidence answer different questions.

Archived primary text read for target-dependent local activation and Dice, especially section5.2. Both are inherited; budget redistribution among detached auxiliary heads is a local extension, not an original DIN reproduction or a claimed new activation.

Pinned benchmark constructor/forward lines30-170 uses categorical/sequence/task hubs, interaction blocks and task MLPs. This study introduces none of these blocks and only reallocates local private heads. Original paper full text unavailable in registry; no original-method novelty or performance comparison.

inherited_components: All executable Model methods from verified source cddac0bb86f76b5a4f8260079beb9f64544819ffa736f70180979cb476297bde; only literal architecture CONFIG changes.
Local DIN-style action-aware scorer and embeddings, uniform/feedback history compression, target-match/order/quadratic detail and rotated duplicate normalization support.
Click/buy networks and source-gradient ownership, initialization/slicing, four outputs and losses, frozen data/optimization/evaluation recipe.
study.proposed_difference: Near-matched private allocations: reference shallow48 without residual (38690 private parameters); shallow42 with residual2 (38382); deep44x32 without residual (38386); deep39x32 with residual2 (38574). Fixed common dense budget166147 and embedding31793216. Replacement comparisons trade width for information/detail or compositional depth; this is not a pure factorial. All modules use existing audited constructor paths, so there is no new scientific architecture claim.
predictions: Click AUC passes the frozen0.0002 preservation gates; buy metrics may remain unchanged. Any clipping-mediated change is recorded rather than assumed away.
At least one residual/depth reallocation meets the predeclared private recovery diagnostic compared with shallow48, showing allocation utility at nearly equal parameter budget.
Dense counts are204837(reference),204529(residual),204533(depth),204721(both); embeddings unchanged. These analytic predictions require host confirmation.
Training and inference may be slower with extra stages despite slightly fewer parameters. Runtime must be measured; combined reallocation can fail the cost-neutral gate.
If both mechanisms complement each other, the combined allocation may improve private recovery over either individual allocation; this would be provisional replacement evidence, confounded by width.
falsifiers: Any preservation-gate AUC loss disqualifies that candidate for click-preserving utility even if auxiliary AUC improves.
No reallocation improves the private recovery diagnostic at comparable cost: no support for the bounded reallocation hypothesis; retain all null/negative results.
Inference wall or p95 >1.02 times contemporaneous shallow reference rejects cost-neutral utility; no repeated >=5% measured reduction against an appropriate rerun reference means no new speed claim.
Differences that disappear with paired seeds or cost repetitions, or are explained by clipping/initialization, do not support a robust information-allocation mechanism.
A signature, masks, allowed-input, ownership, host protocol or numerical failure invalidates that experiment; distinguish missing prerequisites from scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Compensating first widths vary with allocation; this estimates whole allocation utility, not an isolated residual/depth main effect.
Private parameter counts differ by up to 308 total (0.151% of total dense budget); compute, buffers and activation counts are not matched.
Inherited Xavier scale and output slicing change effective function and optimization across widths/depth; no initialization-scale mechanism claim.
Shared dense gradient clipping may couple otherwise detached private heads to click/buy; identical click metrics in one seed do not prove universal independence.
Single fixed-seed screening, validation reuse and run-to-run loading/GPU noise; historical runs are not fresh paired-seed evidence.
The shared detached representation may already lack private-task information; allocation cannot repair upstream source training.
Poor one-pass optimization/calibration rather than representational capacity could explain auxiliary losses. Full-width retained initialization scale changes with slicing.

A small parameter deficit can contribute; nearest budgets are approximate. Auxiliary labels reflect user/category/brand24h matches, not ad-specific conversions; results do not generalize to causal online outcomes.
